verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://consensus.app/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured product summary. Consensus also publishes llms-full.txt and a machine-readable /.well-known/pricing.md, with agent-oriented guidance such as the MCP vs REST parameter names (exclude_preprints vs excludePreprints) for agent workflows. Missing for 10: per-page markdown doc variants (the .md probe returned 404) and independent corroboration of agents using these files.
